newsitem.title: UK: UK appalled by Albanian violence, offers expertise.
newsitem.headline: UK appalled by Albanian violence, offers expertise.

text.p: Britain said on Wednesday it was appalled by growing violence in Albania and repeated its offer of financial expertise to tackle the economic crisis gripping Europe's poorest country.
Three people died in the town of Vlore on Monday when police clashed with thousands of protesters angry with the government's handling of the collapse of pyramid investment schemes.
The Foreign Office said in a statement it was appalled by the violence used by both police and demonstrators.
"We are also deeply concerned by reports of arrests and intimidation of opposition leaders by the authorities in Tirana," it said.
Violence would do nothing to solve the current crisis, the ministry added.

"Both sides should act responsibly and work together to bring peace to the streets of Albania. We urge the Albanian authorities to tackle the underlying economic crisis. Our offer of financial expertise still stands," it said.
